description: The deposit identifies results from peer-to-peer trading in district-heating markets, associated with a study of prosumer participation and network operation. The provider is António Faria; Tiago Soares; José Cunha; Zenaida Mourao. Coverage: No geographic case, reference period, time step or variable definitions are supplied in the short public description. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. The public deposit provides a free access route; downstream software and third-party data may have separate conditions. Limitations: The metadata establish the topic and result deposit but do not establish reusable input data or an executable market model. For simulation it may support comparison of market and prosumer scenarios after the result tables are documented. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
